thread:
olivia: Heads up — deploybot failed to publish the image for release v2.3.1 to eu-west-1 ECR. Partial layers present, attestation lookup returned 412. Logs attached.

deploybot: publish attempt 2024-03-12T12:23:09Z -> ERROR: attestation-validation: signature-timestamp-skew (cosign: timestamp outside allowable range)

raj: Is this a mirror/regional replication issue or a CI build-id mismatch between manifest and attestation?

olivia: Quick check: manifest buildid=20240312-7f1, attestation buildid=20240312-7f2. Looks like a stale staging mirror tried to re-publish an older manifest after attestation rotated. Also saw KMS warn: "signature expired".

sophia: We're inside a change window until 12:45 UTC. Can we pin to the last-known-good digest and proceed with the release notes while we backfill provenance?

raj: +1 to pin. Recommend pinning deployment to digest sha256:abcdef1234567890abcdef so we don't rely on tag semantics. Then promote canary.

tim: Agree. Also need to make sure deploybot's auto-promote won't overwrite the pinned image. Can someone block auto-promote for this job?

olivia: I'm doing a manual override in deploybot now. Also opening a mini-PR to pin manifests. Snippet:
```
containers:
  - name: api
    image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/api@sha256:abcdef1234567890
```

buildbot: created tag staging-20240312 -> sha256:abcdef1234567890 and pushed to staging registry (no attestation attached yet)

deploybot: manual override applied by @olivia: allow-pin sha=sha256:abcdef1234567890 at 12:35 UTC. auto-promote disabled for pipeline redwood-release-v2.3.1

sophia: @raj can you run the eu-west canary (5 RPS for 5m)? If healthy, proceed to 30m canary then full rollout.

raj: launching canary now. Running health checks and a few smoke evals against embedding endpoints.

raj: Canary green after 5m. No anomalies in latency or KV cache hits.

olivia: Proceeding to push pinned release and updating release notes. Draft note: "Release pinned to known-good digest due to regional attestation mismatch; provenance will be backfilled and tag will be re-promoted after verification. No customer-facing downtime expected." Will tag release_notes:v2.3.1-pin.

sophia: Please also add an internal note for platform: investigate why cosign timestamp skew wasn't retried with fallback clock. And add SRE to on-call alert.

tim: Filing INF-2321 to capture logs, KMS timings, and deploybot's cosign flow. Suggest adding a small retry with jitter for attestation timestamp errors.

olivia: Scheduling a 30m change window block on the calendar and pinging SRE channel now.

deploybot: publish complete to eu-west-1 at 12:58 UTC -> digest sha256:abcdef1234567890 (pinned), promotion paused.

sophia: :tada: thanks team. Once INF-2321 has root cause and we confirm attestation is backfilled, we can unpin and re-run normal promote.

raj: Confirmed we should unpin only after matching buildid/attestation and a 1h regression check in prod.

olivia: Closing thread — pinned release pushed, release notes updated, INF-2321 opened. Will follow up when provenance is backfilled.
